notes.zh: 回答中距激光雷达的测距、垂直视场与点频档位，用来判断感知方案的量级。不回答功耗与接口：该产品页未给这两项口径，按「查不到留空」处理，选型时需查其 datasheet。「90 m」是在 10% 反射率条件下的测距，深色或远距离目标会显著缩短。
notes.en: Answers the range, vertical field of view and point rate of a mid-range lidar, which is what sets the order of magnitude of a perception setup. It does not answer power draw or interface: the product page gives neither, so those are left empty rather than guessed and should come from the datasheet. The 90 m figure is at 10% reflectivity, so dark or distant targets shorten it substantially.
